CAG Audit Finds Lapses in Bengaluru Metro Phase 1 and 2

A Comptroller and Auditor General (CAG) audit has revealed significant lapses in Bengaluru Metro's Phase 1 and 2 projects. The audit flagged issues concerning investment and ridership figures. Specifically, the CAG cited the non-integration of Bengaluru Metro with the Bengaluru Metropolitan Transport Corporation (BMTC) as a reason for missed ridership targets. The report indicates widespread financial and operational concerns across both phases of the metro project.
